description:
Loan EMI calculator, SIP calculator and EMI tracker for India. Home loan tax benefit (80C, 24(b)), no-cost EMI, prepayment and step-up EMI, FD, RD, PPF, NPS, Sukanya Samriddhi, SWP, retirement, HRA and GST. Every calculation runs on your device. Only live currency rates need the internet.

LOANS
Calculate EMI, or solve for the amount, rate or tenure you can afford. See the full amortisation schedule month by month, with a chart of how each year splits between principal and interest. Model part payments (once, monthly, quarterly, half-yearly or yearly), advance EMIs, a moratorium, or a change in rate, and see what each one saves. Raise your EMI each year with a step-up EMI and see how soon the loan closes. Compare two offers side by side, fees included.

TRACK EVERY LOAN
Save your loans and mark each EMI as paid. See your total outstanding, the interest still to pay, the date you become debt-free, and the next EMI across all loans. Have extra money? The app shows which loan to prepay first, and how much interest that saves. Get a local reminder before each EMI is due. Add the Next EMI widget to your home screen or lock screen.

HOME LOAN TAX BENEFIT
See the tax you save under Section 80C and Section 24(b) for each financial year. Old and new regime, self-occupied or let out, joint loans, and homes under construction. Export the result as a PDF for your records.

CREDIT CARD AND NO-COST EMI
Find the real cost of a card EMI or a "no-cost" EMI: the GST on interest and the processing fee that you still pay, and the effective rate.

SAVINGS, GOALS AND RETIREMENT
Fixed and recurring deposits, PPF, Sukanya Samriddhi, NPS, SIP, SWP, STP and lumpsum. Find the SIP a goal needs, and the corpus you need to retire. HRA exemption, simple and compound interest, and what inflation does to your money.

EVERYDAY TOOLS
GST, currency conversion, percentages, discounts, tip and bill splitting, fuel cost, date difference and age.

YOUR DATA STAYS YOURS
No account. No ads. No tracking. Your loans are stored only on your device. Lock the app with Face ID. Back up to a file in Files or iCloud Drive, and restore it on a new phone. Export any schedule as a PDF or a CSV file for Excel. Every amount is in rupees with Indian digit grouping. Full dark mode.
promotionalText: EMI tracker with reminders and a home screen widget. See what a prepayment saves, the real cost of a no-cost EMI and your home loan tax benefit. No account, no ads.
whatsNew:
A big update.

- Home loan tax benefit: the tax you save under 80C and 24(b), for each financial year, in the old and new regime.
- Credit card and no-cost EMI: see the GST and fee you still pay.
- My Loans now shows the interest still to pay, your debt-free date and the next EMI across all loans. A new screen shows which loan to prepay first.
- Next EMI widget for the home screen and the lock screen.
- Lock the app with Face ID.
- Back up your loans to a file, and restore them on a new phone.
- Export schedules as CSV for Excel.
- New calculators: goal SIP, retirement, NPS, Sukanya Samriddhi, HRA exemption and step-up EMI.
- Part payments can now repeat every 6 months.
- Face ID now unlocks the app as soon as it opens.
- The amortisation schedule has its own amount, rate and tenure fields.
- Still to pay on a loan opens to show principal and interest.
- Step-up EMI shows the interest and the time you save.
